verdict.rationale: The docs describe connecting via GitHub, GitLab, Azure DevOps or Bitbucket accounts and getting running in 2 minutes. They say feedback arrives "within moments of opening a pull request," and that reviews post actionable inline comments on PR lines alongside walkthrough comments. Community users confirm CodeRabbit runs as a GitHub App posting reviews on their GitHub PRs. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of inline comments on GitLab merge requests specifically, and independent corroboration of the minutes-level turnaround.
